'''White''' can refer to the following:

==White Tower==
* [[White Tower]] - the headquarters of the [[Aes Sedai]].
* [[Hall of the Tower during the White Tower Schism]] - a detailing of the [[Hall of the Tower]] during the Schism.
* [[Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower]] - the state of the White Tower during [[Elaida a'Roihan]]'s reign as [[Amyrlin Seat]].
* [[White Ajah]] - Aes Sedai dedicated to logic, philosophy, and truth.
* [[White Tower Library]] - the largest library in the world.
* [[White Tower Schism]] - a division of the White Tower and the Aes Sedai.

==Chapter titles==
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 26|Whitebridge]]'' - the twenty-sixth chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 18|To the White Tower]]'' - the eighteenth chapter of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 39|Flight from the White Tower]]'' - the thirty-ninth chapter of ''The Great Hunt''.
* ''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 14|White Plumes]]'' - the fourteenth chapter of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.
* ''[[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 16|In the White Tower]]'' - the sixteenth chapter of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.

==''[[Atha'an Miere]]''==
* [[Chanelle din Seran White Shark]] - a [[Windfinder]] of the ''Atha'an Miere''.
* [[Jorin din Jubai White Wing]] - a Windfinder of the ''Atha'an Miere''.
* ''[[Whitecap]]'' - an ''Atha'an Miere'' ship.
* ''[[White Spray]]'' - an ''Atha'an Miere'' soarer.

==[[Inn]]s==
* [[The White Boar]] - an inn in [[Watch Hill]].
* [[The White Ring]] - an inn in [[Maderin]].
* [[The White Tower (inn)]] - an inn in [[Ravinda]].

==Items of the [[One Power]]==
* [[Black and white bird]] - a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that could possibly be used for long-range communication.
* [[Vora's sa'angreal|Vora's ''sa'angreal'']] - a ''[[sa'angreal]]'', sometimes called the "white rod."
* [[White bowl]] - another ''ter'angreal'' that could possibly be used for long-range communications or maybe spying.

==[[Aiel]]==
* [[White Cliff]] - a [[sept]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].
* [[White Mountain]] - a sept of the [[Chareen]] Aiel.

==[[Herbs]]==
* [[Marshwhite]] - an herb that can be brewed into a tea to help calm a queasy stomach.
* [[White henpepper]] - an herb used in soothing a toothache.

==Others==
* [[Children of the Light]] - sometimes called Whitecloaks.
* [[Whitecloak War]] - a confrontation between the Children and [[Altara]].
* [[River Manetherendrelle]] - sometimes called the White River.
* [[Whitebridge]] - a town in Andor.
* [[White Lions]] - a military formation in [[Andor]], sword to the [[Lion Throne]] as opposed to the [[Queen of Andor]].
* [[White Ribbon]] - a symbol of truce in [[Arad Doman]].
* [[White Tail]] - a [[wolf]].
